name: fernhop
description: OpenCode bridge for Claude: hand tasks to OpenCode and the models you set up there, then review the result.
long_description:
Claude plans, delegates and reviews; [OpenCode](https://opencode.ai) does the hands-on work with whatever model you point it at, often a much cheaper one.

**Before installing:** install OpenCode 2.x and configure at least one model in it. Nothing else is needed: the bridge starts and shares one `opencode serve` in the background, reconnects by itself if it dies, and follows OpenCode upgrades.

**Tools:** `run`, `check`, `review_changes`, `session_list`, `interrupt`, `provider_models`, `status`.

All settings are optional. Model aliases (for example `pro` = the newest model whose id contains `pro`) go in `~/.fernhop/config.json`; see the README.

tools.name: run
tools.description: Dispatch a task to OpenCode; waits up to ~50 s, then returns the result or a session id to keep waiting on.

tools.name: check
tools.description: Status and latest output of a session; can wait for it to finish.

tools.name: review_changes
tools.description: Files changed by a session, or git status of a directory.

tools.name: session_list
tools.description: Recent OpenCode sessions with outcome, model and directory.

tools.name: provider_models
tools.description: Models by provider, the default model, and your aliases.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Bridge health: versions, the serve in use, running tasks, recent errors; can restart the serve.

opencode_executable.title: OpenCode executable
opencode_executable.description: Optional. Leave empty to find it automatically. On Windows choose opencode.exe inside the npm package folder, not opencode.cmd.

alias_config.title: Model alias file
alias_config.description: Optional. A JSON file with model aliases. Leave empty to use ~/.fernhop/config.json if it exists.

port.title: First port
port.description: Port for the shared opencode serve. If it is taken, the next 9 ports are tried.
